parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ConsumerStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the consumer. Valid values:

*   true: The consumer is enabled.
*   false: The consumer is disabled.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-auth-consumer-status --gateway-unique-id gw-685f661467b54f48b7b7a76605ce0000 --id 1 --consumer-status true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateGatewayAuthConsumerStatus --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-685f661467b54f48b7b7a76605ce0000' --ConsumerStatus true --AcceptLanguage zh --Id 1
